components.exists_for: Byte-exact structural parse of v5 .reg into deterministic JSON; strict malformed handling (exit 3).
Mechanical before/after comparison of two parse documents, order-sensitive.
Confined exact-type corpus seeder (own HKCU scratch keys only); incl. REG_NONE via .NET exact kind.
Reproducible 23-probe runner: seed, dual-emitter export, parse, byte-compare, import round-trip, sanitized evidence.

claims.scope: regedit.exe /e + reg.exe export, Windows 10 Home build 26200
claims.text: Both emitters produce byte-identical output on all 23 probes.

Hex payload lines: first line carries max(1, ceil((77-P)/3)) bytes where P is the rendered prefix width (quoted name + '=hex:'), continuations carry 25 bytes (backslash continuation, 2-space indent, trailing comma kept). The earlier floor((77-P)/3) formula coincided at the old probe points (77-P divisible by 3 there) and is superseded.

claims.scope: same; ordering evidence ASCII names only
claims.text: Subkey sections export in ASCII case-folded stable order; values export in registry enumeration (creation) order, including mixed-case ASCII value names.
Delete-import-reexport round-trips are byte-identical on all 23 probes, including MULTI_SZ empty elements and REG_NONE (hex(0)) 3-byte and empty payloads.
dword is 8 lowercase zero-padded hex; QWORD is hex(b) little-endian; EXPAND_SZ stored unexpanded with NUL terminator; REG_NONE is emitted as hex(0) (bare colon when empty).

claims.scope: same; probes K14-K18 (prefix widths 27..107, one 30-byte payload)
claims.text: Axis A resolved: long-name prefixes shift the first wrap per the ceil+min-one rule (K14 17 bytes at P=27 refutes floor; K15-K18 carry 1 first-line byte at P=76..107); continuations hold 25; both emitters agree byte-for-byte; round-trips clean.

Axis B resolved for ASCII: subkeys [b1,A1,B2,a2] export as [A1,a2,b1,B2] (case-folded stable, not ordinal); values [zeta,Alpha,MID,beta] keep creation order. Tie-break pairs (Ab vs aB) are UNPRODUCIBLE: the namespace folds case at identity (scratch-proven: one key survives).

Axis C resolved for REG_NONE: producible via .NET exact-type seeding; both emitters emit hex(0) (3-byte payload and bare empty); import round-trip preserves discriminant and bytes. Other exotic discriminants (4,5,6,8,9,10) are UNPRODUCIBLE_WITH_CURRENT_ORACLE (no exact-type API; native APIs out of scope).

claims.scope: same; residual unknowns: non-ASCII ordering, tie-break (unproducible by construction), non-REG_NONE exotic discriminants (unproducible with oracle)
claims.text: R6 closed: all three axes exercised with dual-emitter + round-trip evidence (R6a/R6b/R6c). No locale/Unicode ordering claimed; no universal-Windows claim.

determinism.note: delete + import own export + re-export is byte-identical (23/23); no wall-clock or machine bytes in v5 text exports.

privacy.scan: synthetic key/value names only; no user paths, SIDs, or machine data in matrix.json
